ReasonforDeviation_Q3: There has been a significant delay in the registration of title deeds, specifically for the batch lodged in December 2023, which was only registered in January 2024. This delay has created challenges for the timely processing and finalization of Government-subsidized housing transactions. The typical process for registering title deeds includes the following stages: Data Preparation, Assigned to Examiner Level 1, Assigned to Examiner Level 2, Deeds Preparation, Final Black Book, Execution, Numbering, Data Capturing, Microfilm, and Delivery. Each of these steps requires a certain amount of time, but the cumulative effect of delays in any of these stages results in a prolonged registration process.
CorrectiveAction_Q3: A formal letter will be written to the Registrar of Deeds, requesting the expedited processing of registration for Government-subsidized housing title deeds. This will prioritize the registration of these deeds to ensure timely completion. Regular monitoring of the registration process will be implemented to track progress and identify any future bottlenecks in the system.
ReasonforDeviation_Q4:
There were delays in processing and lodging of title deeds due to the following reasons: 
1.	Rejections at Huhudi which were later resolved
2.	The delay of the name change of Ventersdorp Ext 12 to JB Marks.
3.	Tshing Ext 9 was not gazette which delayed the processing of title deeds
CorrectiveAction_Q4:
1. 51 Title deeds which will be registerd in Quarter 1 of 2025/26 in respect of HUhudi.
2. The proclamation of Tshing Ext 9 has been gazetted and the title deeds will be relodged in the new financial year.
